title: Entry Documents by Program for the Workers' Compensation Referral
content:
# Entry documents by program

For each program under the Workers' Compensation Referral, the schedule marks which documents the program requires at entry. "Yes" means the program requires that document; "No" means it does not.

| Program | Physician order | Employer job description | Completed FCE | Return-to-work goal | Employer incident report |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Employer Direct Early Intervention | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy | Yes | No | No | No | No |
| Work Conditioning Program | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Work Hardening Program | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Functional Capacity Evaluation | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |

## Entry conditions of each program

Each program also carries its own entry conditions:

| Program | Entry conditions |
|---|---|
| Employer Direct Early Intervention | an employer direct contract, the employer's incident report on file, and no claim filed |
| Workers' Comp Outpatient Therapy | a claim number and a physician order on file |
| Workers' Comp Post-Surgical Therapy | a claim number, a physician order and the surgery date on file |
| Work Conditioning Program | a claim number, a physician order and the employer's job description on file, and a return-to-work goal |
| Work Hardening Program | a claim number, a physician order, the employer's job description and a completed FCE baseline on file, and a return-to-work goal |
| Functional Capacity Evaluation | a claim number, a physician order and the employer's job description on file |

## What each column means

- **Physician order** — whether a treating physician's order must be on file before the first visit.
- **Employer job description** — whether the employer's written job description must be on file before the first visit.
- **Completed FCE** — whether a completed Functional Capacity Evaluation must be on file before entry.
- **Return-to-work goal** — whether a written return-to-work goal agreed with the employer is required at entry.
- **Employer incident report** — whether the employer's incident report must be on file before the first visit.

## Reading across the programs

- Employer Direct Early Intervention is the only program that requires the employer's incident report, and it requires none of the other documents.
- Every other program requires a physician order.
- The employer's job description is required by Work Conditioning Program, Work Hardening Program and Functional Capacity Evaluation.
- A completed Functional Capacity Evaluation is required only by Work Hardening Program.
- A return-to-work goal is required by Work Conditioning Program and Work Hardening Program.
